responsibility: Implements conversion of GIMPLE out of SSA form, including PHI elimination and temporary expression replacement support for expansion. It decides which SSA assignments are replaceable, inserts special backedge copies to avoid problematic PHI lowering cases, removes useless PHIs, builds and uses elimination/coalescing data around CFG edges, and drives rewrite_out_of_ssa so later RTL expansion sees ordinary variables/register partitions instead of SSA names.
same_name_distinction: Implements the out-of-SSA transformation itself: it performs PHI elimination, inserts needed copies on CFG/backedges, removes useless PHIs, and drives rewrite_out_of_ssa/finish_out_of_ssa. Unlike the header, this is the executable pass logic rather than the shared ssaexpand state and API declarations.
